method.patient_resampling: whole test patients with replacement; duplicate draws relabelled as distinct bootstrap patients
method.timepoint_eligibility: at least five distinct test-patient copies and both outcomes
method.A0: recomputed patient event rate over the scored test period
method.A0_time_pooled_population: all scored test observations; forecast = training-cohort event rate per time point (fixed across resamples)
method.centering_scale: probability; cohort mean is the row-weighted mean of test GB forecasts
